Every other flag is common, which is the set's third frozen choice written down: the diff between two arms is the whole of the difference between them. No start is named here because tournaments/ is gitignored and a committed manifest that cannot run on a fresh clone is not one -- pass --from the shipped league's main, written out as a checkpoint, and every arm begins where the shipped mind did.
